# The walk contract

A walk is a query, never a load. If a hop parses a file, it is not a traversal.

## Edges

Every edge is structural, a wormhole, or an admitted weld.

### Structural

Built at ingest from the syntax tree. One producer among several; the tree is never
the contract.

### Wormhole

The same literal is a node id in two or more graphs. Free by construction — no work,
no tokens, no decision.

### Weld

An exact, byte-identical literal carried by two or more rostered corpora, admitted
through the gate. Similarity alone parks forever and never graduates.

## Refusals

An absent tenant refuses. An absent container refuses and names its build command.
A directionless adjacency is refused rather than given an invented direction.

### Why refusal beats a default

A default is an answer nobody checked. The silent wrong answer costs more than the
loud missing one, and only the loud one gets fixed.
